name: lci_routing_table
description: GET /status/routes CBOR payload vectors (spec 11-lci.md section 17.5.3). Pins the routing table document shape: {routes: [{prefix, via, metric, lifetime_s}...], default_route}. Bytes are produced by RoutesResource.render_get over StaticNodeInfo (lichen.coap.resources.node_resources); encoded_hex equals cbor2.dumps of the pinned input. The resource is a read-only GET surface with no rejection path, so this family has no negative vectors.

vectors.name: routes_empty_no_default
vectors.description: Node with no routes and no default route (null).

vectors.name: routes_single_spec_example
vectors.description: Single RPL route matching the spec 17.5.3 example: Yggdrasil-native prefix via link-local next hop, metric 512, lifetime 1800 s, same next hop as default route.

vectors.name: routes_multi_no_default
vectors.description: Two mesh routes with different metrics/lifetimes and no default route (isolated mesh, non-storing mode downward routes held by the border router).
